caption: A new account on the Free plan starts with a balance of 10,000 credits, all 10,000 remaining.
Our test text of exactly 500 characters, with the counter at 500 / 10,000 characters before we clicked Generate speech.
About 7 seconds after the click, audio was playing. One click gave two versions, each 0:39 long, and the panel then recommended other voices.
The account menu after generating: 9,500 of 10,000 credits left, so 500 characters cost 500 credits even though two versions came out.
Subscription page: 500 of 10,000 credits used. On Free the commercial license for Speech and Music is crossed out; Starter includes it.
Stripe checkout for Starter in euro: 5.65 minus a first month promotion of 4.71, plus 0.20 VAT, so 1.14 euros today and 6.85 euros a month after that. The email field is hidden.
Settings, Profile: Delete Entire Account warns that the email address can no longer be used for a new ElevenLabs account. We did not press it.
